request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work (law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, company and plant
documents) using ONLY the documents in the current folder, one text file per document; README.md lists them with their rank. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need: search in English and in Italian, follow references from one article or annex to another, and read the whole section before you rely on it.

Rules:
- Use only the files. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- Answer only if a passage states the answer for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the same article
  and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline). A passage about a neighbouring subject does not
  answer the question: then the kind is "unknown" and the value is null. A question about something that happened
  (the date of the last check, whether something is overdue today) is "unknown" unless a passage records that event.
- A passage marked "corrected by the corrigendum" already shows the corrected wording: reason with it. The old
  wording, given in the mark, is no longer valid.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the passages, one by one. A repeal or an
  application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a date is still fully in
  force on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does not yet bind on earlier days.
- When passages of different rank disagree, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's manual,
  then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.) wins over a
  ministerial decree (DM). Say which one wins.
- A row of a table belongs to the thing named in that same row. Read the row of the item asked about, not a
  neighbouring row. When the question itself states a condition ("if it were in regular use", "built in 2017"),
  reason with that condition.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / by which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "how often / for how
  long / within what time" is "duration"; "can / may / is / does / must" is "boolean"; "which / what (several
  things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition is "text" (one short sentence naming every element asked for).
- Point at the evidence: for every passage you rely on, copy word for word the sentence, or the table row, that
  states what you use. Copy exactly, without changing a character; do not join text from two places.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not state it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "what the passages say and how it leads to the answer, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y", "P6M", "P45D", "PT1H" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "evidence": [{"file": "<file name>", "quote": "<copied exactly from that file, one sentence or one table row>"}]}
request.prompt:
Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: A machine is placed on the market on 1 March 2027. For how long at least, after it has been placed on the market or put into service, must the manufacturer keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities?

What the fact store already holds on this question (facts taken earlier from these same documents, each with the
sentence it comes from). They are leads, not the answer: a fact can be incomplete, about a neighbouring subject,
or wrong. Check each one you use against the files, and search further whenever they do not settle the question.
The store's own answer: "P10Y" - At least 10 years after the machine is placed on the market or put into service, under Article 10(3) of the Regulation, since the Regulation applies from 20 January 2027.
Facts (subject | relation | value | condition | [document, place]):
- technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity | retention period | at least 10 years (P10Y) | if: after the machinery or the related product has been placed on the market or put into service | [REG, Art. 10(3)] | sentence: "Manufacturers shall keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities for at least 10 years after the machinery or the related product has been placed on the market or put into service."
- Regulation | applies from | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | if: However, the following Articles shall apply from the following dates | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 10] [note: 2027-03-01 is 40 days after 2027-01-20] | sentence: "read: ‘ 20 January 2027 ’."
- copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical documentation kept by manufacturer | retention period | for at least 10 years (P10Y) | if: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service | [REG, Annex VII, 7] | sentence: "The manufacturer shall keep a copy of the EU type-examination certificate, its annexes and additions, together with the technical documentation at the disposal of the national authorities, for at least 10 years after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service."
- technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity | retention period | at least 10 years (P10Y) | if: after the product has been placed on the market | [REG, Art. 12(2)] | sentence: "(a) keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of conformity of machinery and related products or the EU declaration of incorporation of partly completed machinery at the disposal of the national market surveillance authorities for at least 10 years after the product has been placed on the market;"
- technical documentation and EU declaration of incorporation | retention period | at least 10 years (P10Y) | if: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market | [REG, Art. 11(3)] | sentence: "Manufacturers shall keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of incorporation at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities for at least 10 years after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market."
- copy of the EU declaration of conformity | retention period | for at least 10 years (P10Y) | if: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market | [REG, Art. 13(8)] | sentence: "Importers shall, for at least 10 years after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market, keep a copy of the EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities and ensure that the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A, can be made available to those authorities upon request."
- copy of EU declaration of incorporation, kept by importers | retention period | at least 10 years (P10Y) | if: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market | [REG, Art. 14(7)] | sentence: "Importers shall, for at least 10 years after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market, keep a copy of the EU declaration of incorporation at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities and ensure that the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B can be made available to those authorities upon request."
- digital EU declarations of incorporation | retention period | for at least 10 years (P10Y) | if: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery | [REG, Art. 11(8)] | sentence: "Digital EU declarations of incorporation shall be made accessible online for at least 10 years after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery."
- fabbricante ovvero soggetti della catena della distribuzione | has obligation | dall'organo di vigilanza territorialmente competente | if: qualora, alla conclusione dell'accertamento tecnico effettuato dall'autorità nazionale per la sorveglianza del mercato, risulti la non conformità dell'attrezzatura | [DLGS70, art. 70, c. 4] | sentence: "b) dall'organo di vigilanza territorialmente competente rispettivamente, nei confronti del fabbricante ovvero dei soggetti della catena della distribuzione, qualora, alla conclusione dell'accertamento tecnico effettuato dall'autorità nazionale per la sorveglianza del mercato, risulti la non conformità dell'attrezzatura ad uno o più requisiti essenziali di sicurezza previsti dalle disposizioni legi"
- digital EU declarations of conformity | retention period | for at least 10 years (P10Y) | if: in any event | [REG, Art. 10(8)] | sentence: "Digital EU declarations of conformity shall be made accessible online for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product and in any event for at least 10 years after the placing on the market or the putting into service of the machinery or related product."
- original EC declaration of conformity | retention period | at least 10 years (P10Y) | [DIR, Annex II, 2] | sentence: "CUSTODY The manufacturer of machinery or his authorised representative shall keep the original EC declaration of conformity for a period of at least 10 years from the last date of manufacture of the machinery."
- importers | has obligation | keep a copy of the EU declaration of conformity at the disposal… | [REG, Art. 13(8)] | sentence: "Importers shall, for at least 10 years after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market, keep a copy of the EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities and ensure that the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A, can be made available to those authorities upon request."
- digital instructions, manufacturer | retention period | make them accessible online during the expected lifetime (for at least 10 years) | if: after the placing on the market of the machinery or related product | [REG, Art. 10(7)] | sentence: "(c) make them accessible online during the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product and for at least 10 years after the placing on the market of the machinery or related product."
